title: Understanding Constant Velocity
text: When an object moves with constant velocity, what can we say about the net force acting on it?

title: Net Force and Constant Velocity
text: If an object is moving with constant velocity, the net force acting on it is zero. This means the sum of all forces acting on the object must be zero.

title: Setting Up the Equation
text: Given that the net force is zero, set up the equation: $$\vec{F}_1+\vec{F}_2+\vec{F}_3=0,$$ where $$\vec{F}_3$$ is the unknown force.

title: Solving for the Third Force
text: Rearrange the equation to solve for $$\vec{F}_3:$$ $$\vec{F}_3=-(\vec{F}_1+\vec{F}_2)$$.

title: Calculating the Components
text: Calculate the components of $$\vec{F}_3$$ by substituting the given values of $$\vec{F}_1$$ and $$\vec{F}_2$$ into the equation.

title: Final Calculation
text: Substitute $$\vec{F}_1=3\hat{i}+5\hat{j}$$ and $$\vec{F}_2=4\hat{i}-7\hat{j}$$ into the equation $$\vec{F}_3=-(\vec{F}_1+\vec{F}_2)$$ to find $$\vec{F}_3$$.
